summary: A modular visual system converts audience and platform hypotheses into four production-ready composition specifications while keeping claims and asset rights gated.

visual_system.narrative: Move from tactile evidence to routine clarity, then to a restrained product reveal.
visual_system.lighting: soft directional daylight with controlled specular highlights
visual_system.texture_language: watery serum bead, thin spread, clean glass reflections
visual_system.camera_language: macro evidence, eye-level routine context, centered commerce packshot

modules.name: Texture Truth
modules.goal: Communicate lightweight texture without implying efficacy.
modules.shot: extreme macro serum droplet on transparent glass applicator
modules.motion: slow droplet formation and clean spread
modules.copy_zone: upper-left safe area, maximum seven words

modules.name: Routine Placement
modules.goal: Explain application order at a glance.
modules.shot: clean bathroom shelf with cleanser, generic serum bottle, moisturizer, and sunscreen represented as unlabeled neutral props

modules.name: Creator Countertop
modules.goal: Create a credible social-first product discovery moment.
modules.shot: inclusive adult creator hand presenting an unlabeled serum bottle beside a mirror in natural morning light
modules.motion: handheld reach, cap open, one controlled drop
modules.copy_zone: lower-third captions within platform safe area
required_assets: model release or fully synthetic person approval

modules.name: Commerce Clarity
modules.shot: centered bottle on warm ivory surface with restrained ingredient-shape abstractions behind it
review_flags: ingredient forms are decorative, not molecular proof

production_rules: Generate backgrounds and compositions separately from final package artwork
Composite the approved packshot after generation
Keep text outside the image model and add it in design tooling
Preserve a prompt version, seed, model, source assets, and reviewer decision for each output
success_criteria: human reviewer can trace every high-risk element

risks: Skin depiction may become unrealistically perfected
Decorative ingredient imagery may be misread as scientific evidence
next_actions: Run prompt drafts with neutral packaging only
Submit selected frames to compliance and design review
